sloka: ते तस्य तेजसा दग्धाः सैन्या वैवस्वतस्य तु ।रणे तस्मिन्निपतिता दावदग्धा नगा इव ।। ७.२१.४५ ॥
transliteration: te tasya tejasā dagdhāḥ sainyā vaivasvatasya tu ।raṇe tasminnipatitā dāvadagdhā nagā iva ।। 7.21.45 ॥

translations.english: Yama's armies, burnt by the enemy's power in that battle, fell down like trees consumed by a forest fire.
